verdict.rationale: Jan's Settings and Hub cover model management: importing local GGUF files, searching Hugging Face IDs, and pausing or resuming downloads. Custom Assistants hold reusable instructions and personas that can be assigned to projects, which roughly serves as saved prompts. There is no evidence of per-model configuration such as inference parameters or context settings, nor that these are managed together in a single unified view. Missing for 10: per-model configuration settings, evidence of a unified management view, a dedicated saved-prompt library, independent hands-on corroboration.
